businesses.business: Payroll and HR software and services

offering_description.value: Asure sells cloud payroll, time tracking, benefits administration, and HR software to small and midsize employers. It also handles payroll tax filings and payments for employers and payroll providers, and offers outsourced HR support.

primary_products.value: Payroll software; time and attendance software; HR management software; benefits administration software; payroll tax software

primary_services.value: Payroll processing; payroll tax filing and remittance; outsourced HR support; HR compliance consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: Small and midsize employers, payroll service bureaus, and other payroll providers

end_markets.value: Employer payroll and HR administration across industries; payroll outsourcing

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring access to cloud payroll, time tracking, benefits, and HR software; service fees: Payroll processing, payroll tax administration, and outsourced HR support

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Turns employer payroll, time, and personnel data into workflows for employers and payroll providers; service provider: Uses employer records to process payroll, remit taxes, and provide HR support

geography_served.value: US national: Employers and payroll providers across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Payroll, payroll tax compliance, time tracking, benefits administration, and HR management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving employers and payroll providers; partners / resellers: Payroll service bureaus and other providers that offer Asure software or services to employers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Federal, state, and local payroll tax rules, wage and hour laws, and employee data privacy requirements
